format: NetCDF4 (GSI diag .nc4, whole-file download, read with h5netcdf)
origin: AWS S3 s3://noaa-ufs-gefsv13replay-pds (us-east-1, anonymous, via obstore)
notes: HealDA reads a 24 h window [t-21h, t+3h] via time_tolerance=(timedelta(hours=-21), timedelta(hours=3)) (examples/05_data_assimilation/02_healda.py:101,111; recipes/eval/cfg/model/healda.yaml time_tolerance_hours: [-21, 3]). The harness only builds symmetric tolerances, so the same absolute window for analysis time 2024-01-01T00 (2023-12-31T03 .. 2024-01-01T03) is expressed as time=2023-12-31T15:00 with time_tolerance_hours=12.
HealDA's conventional list equals the full GSIConventionalLexicon VOCAB (8 keys, earth2studio/lexicon/ufs.py:41-60).
u and v share one diag file (conv_uv), and gps/gps_t/gps_q share conv_gps; whether the source de-duplicates those downloads was not checked.
Validity check in code is only time >= 1980-01-01 (ufs.py:_validate_time); missing diag files are tolerated, so an unavailable time returns an empty frame rather than an error.
Returns a pandas DataFrame (DataFrameSource); HealDA also passes fields= (schema column subset), which the generic harness path does not, so all SCHEMA columns are returned.
decode_workers defaults to 'auto' (process pool for diag decoding); left at default.
